notes.title: Small post launch patch
notes.content:
Finding a lot of new bugs playing the steam version of the game will be working on a patch fixing most of the known bugs around Februaryish. Also still in school so might come out later 
The known bugs
High score file not being read properly 
Hitting an enemy at the edge of the map can lead to player clipping though the border of the level
If you find anymore bugs or problems join the discord server and let me know
